== Biography ==
=== Samuel Glasgow, Jr. 1777 - 1869 ===
Birth:	Nov 4 1777  Maryland, United States

Parents: Son of Mary (Stephenson) and Samuel Glasgow. 

Married: Margaret Jameson. They had 11 children - Rhoda, Ephraim, Nathaniel, Thomas, David, Louisa Jane, Rose Ann, Nancy, Elizabeth and two more unknown daughter. 

:Death:	June 24 1869  Davis County, Iowa, United States
:Burial:	June 1869 Glasgow Cemetery, Eldon, Davis, Iowa, United States

Father:	Samuel Glasgow, Sr.
Mother:	Mary Glasgow (born Stephenson)

Wife:	Margaret Glasgow (born Jamison) - Margaret [162], b. Oct. 7, 1779; ni. Samuel Glasgow. <ref>https://archive.org/stream/jamesonsinameric00jame/jamesonsinameric00jame_djvu.txt</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1133]] is assessed at 94% (proved). The Jamesons in America account explicitly calls Margaret Jameson’s husband Samuel the son of Samuel and Mary Stephenson, gives his 4 September 1777 Maryland birth, and follows the same Virginia–Kentucky–Indiana–Iowa family. This is substantially more specific than an inherited parent field.

Confident compiled-family identification; it does not settle the conflicting November birth statement elsewhere in the profile.

Next useful test: Compare the family history’s parent account with Samuel senior’s probate or family register.

Margaret^ Jameson {Thomas? John;- Jamcs^), daughter of Thomas

Co., Va. She married Samuel Glasgow, son of Samuel and Mary (Stephen- 
son) Glasgow. He was born Sept. 4, 1777, in Maryland. They resided in 
Virginia, Kentuck)', Indiana, and died in Iowa. Mr. Glasgow died in 1870. 
Mrs. Glasgow died in 1864.
